answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 49837 Country: India Title: Name Question: Azal name is good or not? Answer ID: 49837 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 156/117/L=01/1435) Azal means removal, ineffectiveness and suspension etc. You should choose any name among the names of prophets, sahabah or awliya. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
